把因为排版被断开的行接回一段（PDF、窄栏复制最常见）；句末标点结尾、列表、编号: Re-join lines that wrapping split apart (most common with PDFs and narrow columns); lines ending in punctuation, list items, numbered lines, and tables are left alone
全角字母数字与标点收成半角（Ａ→A、１２３→123、（→(、，→,）；中文标点。: Fold full-width letters, digits, and punctuation to half-width (Ａ→A, １２３→123, （→(, ，→,); Chinese punctuation such as 。、《》 is left as it is
去掉识别噪声：乱码占位符、控制字符、零宽字符、私用区字符。正常标点、emoji、: Strip OCR noise: mojibake placeholders, control characters, zero-width characters, private-use characters. Normal punctuation, emoji, and rare characters stay
只保留单词与单词、单词与中文之间的空格，其余全部去掉（并把多余空格折叠成一个）: Keep only the spaces between words, and between words and Chinese; drop the rest (and collapse runs of spaces into one)
只看哪一段（已有结果，不会重新识别）: Jump to a paragraph (uses the existing result, doesn't recognise again)
划了一段就复制那一段，没划就复制全部: Copies just the part you selected, or everything if nothing is selected
删掉识别文本里的所有空格（换行保留）: Remove every space from the recognised text (line breaks stay)
一条链接开一个标签页（默认关）: Open each link in its own tab (off by default)
点击展开 / 收起截图: Click to expand / collapse the screenshot
打开识别到的链接: Open the links that were found
点击查看原尺寸: Click to view at full size
用 AI 模型识别主体并抠掉背景（神经网络语义分割 + 边缘去色）: Detect the subject with an AI model and cut the background out (neural-net segmentation plus edge de-fringing)
修瑕疵：涂掉多余的部分 / 保住该留的部分（可在结果图上直接涂）: Touch up: paint away leftovers, or protect what should stay (paint straight on the result)
把当前结果另存为一份图片文件（不改动横条上的图标）: Save the current result as an image file (the bar's icon is left alone)
调整 AI 抠图的参数（会影响模型后处理与边缘）: Tune the AI cutout parameters (they affect post-processing and the edges)
涂过的部分会保留（补描：AI 抠错的地方救回来）: Painted areas are kept (touch-up: rescue the places the AI got wrong)
放大看细节再涂 —— 小瑕疵不放大很容易涂错地方: Zoom in before painting — small flaws are easy to paint over in the wrong spot
临时换一个模型重抠（不影响设置里选的默认模型）: Use another model for this cutout (the default chosen in Settings is unchanged)
涂过的部分会被擦掉（抠完有小瑕疵时用这个）: Painted areas are erased (use this when the cutout has small flaws)
丢弃所有涂抹（回到 AI 刚抠完的样子）: Discard all the painting (back to the fresh cutout)
不消除背景，把这张原图直接设成图标: Keep the background and use this image as the icon as-is
把上面所有参数恢复成实测的推荐值: Reset every parameter above to the measured defaults
